nameRules.evidence: The web service tag identifies the app that serves the project UI and HTTP API.
The mcp service tag identifies the project's tool server.

flows.name: View a health model
flows.evidence: Project goal: choose a model, load its graph and open live updates.

systems.name: List available models
systems.evidence: The model picker reads the catalog.

requires.evidence: The web API serves the model catalog.

requests.evidence: HTTP outcome of the catalog request.

systems.name: Load the model graph
systems.evidence: The graph needs the selected model, its entities and their relationships.

requires.evidence: The graph request enters through the web service.

requests.evidence: HTTP outcome of the graph request.

spans.evidence: List the entities in the selected model.
List the relationships in the selected model.

systems.name: Open live updates
systems.evidence: The UI opens a stream for model changes.

requires.evidence: The web service exposes the stream.

requests.evidence: HTTP outcome when opening the stream.

flows.name: Run a Task
flows.evidence: Project goal: submit work in a session, run the agent and inspect task events.

systems.name: Submit a task
systems.evidence: A session accepts a new unit of work.

requires.evidence: The web service receives the task submission.

requests.evidence: HTTP outcome when submitting a task.

spans.evidence: The task handler creates a task record.

systems.name: Run the agent
systems.evidence: The task handler invokes the agent.

requires.evidence: The web service owns the instrumented task handler.

spans.evidence: The agent invocation is a direct child of a task request.

systems.name: Read task events
systems.evidence: Users follow task progress from the event stream.

requires.evidence: The web service exposes task events.

requests.evidence: HTTP outcome when reading the task event stream.

flows.name: Send a health report
flows.evidence: Project goal: submit a state report for one entity and have Azure apply it.

systems.name: Receive the entity report
systems.evidence: A report enters through the entity endpoint.

requires.evidence: The web service receives the report.

requests.evidence: HTTP outcome of an entity report submission.

systems.name: Read the reporting context
systems.evidence: The report handler looks up the model that contains the target entity.

requires.evidence: The lookup runs inside the web report handler.

spans.evidence: The handler reads the target health model.

systems.name: Confirm the reported state
systems.evidence: The business outcome requires a receipt that the target applied the reported state. No such receipt is bound.

flows.name: Apply approved changes
flows.evidence: Project goal: authorize a change, write the graph and record the result.

systems.name: Verify the approval
systems.evidence: The workflow requires approval. The captured route and SDK metrics do not identify an approval decision.

systems.name: Write model entities and relationships
systems.evidence: The tool request writes the two kinds of model data. Other commands share this route.

requires.evidence: The instrumented tool request enters through the web service.

systems.name: Append the apply record
systems.evidence: The workflow records each apply operation in its session history.

requires.evidence: The instrumented tool request enters through the web service.

spans.evidence: The session store appends an apply record.
